items.claim: Stanley Dorsville's spinny attacks might leave him open to being taken down and controlled.
items.quote: There's a little bit of spinny merchant stuff that I don't know if that's the greatest. Maybe that's a way that he ends up getting taken down, controlled a little bit, but I'm not so sure about that.

items.claim: Stanley Dorsville has shown a killer instinct and quality wins on the regional scene.
items.quote: I saw like the killer instinct that you were kind of referring to. He's been underestimated on the regional scene coming up, but like his wins on the regional scene are pretty quality.

items.claim: Jackson McVey is more well-rounded and offers a lot more on the feet than Wesley Schultz.
items.quote: I think he's more well-rounded on like he's got a lot more to offer on the feet.

items.claim: Wesley Schultz has bad cardio and gases out too much.
items.quote: Wes Schultz just gas is way too much for my liking.

items.claim: Wesley Schultz showed resolve and made it to the third round despite getting beaten up against Ben Johnson.
items.quote: that last fight against Ben Johnson, he got his ass kicked and he stuck with it. He showed some resolve. He showed some gumption.

items.claim: Wesley Schultz has a nasty submission game and can wrestle at a D2 level.
items.quote: the guy does have a nasty submission game and usually that's his path of victory is to snatch up on something... He wrestled D2 level.

items.claim: Jackson McVey's takedown defense and submission defense do not look very good on film.
items.quote: I'm more concerned with his takedown defense and his submission defense

items.claim: Jackson McVey was easily taken down and submitted by Bruno Ferrer and Zach Reese.
items.quote: if you're getting subbed by Zack Ree and Bruno Ferrer, there's a good chance that Wes Schultz is going to be able to get that spot as well.
